modalities.evidence: Large Single-Subject Functional MRI Datasets at 7T
All functional runs had the same organization of blocks
to perform a letter/number discrimination task

output.population: Three subjects with no known history of neurological disorders (2 females; age=25±2.5 years)
output.summary: Three subjects each completed 100 functional runs at 7T with identical block structure, performing one of three visual stimulation and attention tasks with interleaved rest periods.
